canonical_project: Central Bank of Montenegro DR Micro Data Center (built by Cikom)
owner: Central Bank of Montenegro (CBCG); built by Cikom
notes: Cikom profile article (Vijesti promo, 2024-07-05) names 'DR sajt Centralne banke CG na Zabljaku (Mikro Data Centar)' - a disaster-recovery micro data center for the Central Bank of Montenegro in Zabljak, plus a Triple Micro Data Center at CBCG. ICT Cortex profile confirms Cikom's data center infrastructure service line. Enterprise/internal DR facility, not commercial colocation; official CBCG procurement confirmation not found.
